headlines.title: Qualcomm CEO on SpaceX deal: 'It's a great partnership' that will drive 'innovation'
headlines.summary: Qualcomm (QCOM) CEO Cristiano Amon joins Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi and Yahoo Finance host Deirdre Bosa at Yahoo Finance's 2026 Invest conference to discuss the company's recently announced 5G deal with SpaceX (SPCX).

news.summary: Yahoo Finance's 2026 Invest conference coverage included United Airlines' CEO describing Starlink as a major competitive advantage and Qualcomm's CEO discussing a recently announced 5G deal with SpaceX. A Bloomberg report, cited by Yahoo Finance, said SpaceX and Tesla are in talks about a potential merger. Binance co-founder CZ said the exchange did not sell any SpaceX stock during a recent hack and addressed his dispute with Elon Musk.

headlines.summary: Palantir Technologies (NasdaqGS:PLTR) faces fresh European competition as Helsing GmbH unveils its Clarity AI defense platform. On Wednesday (Nov. 11), German drone maker Helsing unveiled Clarity, an agentic intelligence platform for the military. The $18 billion startup said that the platform is built around customised AI agents trained on military data to help armed forces to process data, identify threats and counter them. news.summary: Palantir shares fell more than 20% in a week after what 24/7 Wall St. describes as the stock's worst week in months, with Trefis citing a price of $172.
